title: Production of pazopanib hydrochloride nanoparticles (anti-kidney cancer drug) using a supercritical gas antisolvent (GAS) method
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39844-39857
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07079H, Paper

Majid Bazaei, Bizhan Honarvar, Nadia Esfandiari, Seyed Ali Sajadian, Zahra Arab Aboosadi
Supercritical fluid-based methods have been receiving increasing popularity in the production of pharmaceutical nanoparticles due to their ability to control the size and distribution of the particles and offer high purity products.
